fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2005, for every one dollar increase in the price of crude oil, our annual fuel expense would increase by approximately $40 million (implies ~1,680 million projected gallons for 2005).

instrument_type_details.notes: As of December 31, 2004, did not have any fuel price hedges in place. However, in prior year 2004, the company had fuel hedging activities that resulted in $74 million of gains. The Q1 2003 hedges from Dec 31, 2002 appear to have settled and no new hedges were entered.

warnings: No fuel hedges in place at December 31, 2004. Hedging gains of $74 million recognized in FY2004 from prior positions.
